description: As compliant, but the stub's exchange clock runs 6 s ahead of the injected now and the signed probe fails on recv_window with the 10002 reply of the shared corpus.

expected.outcome: Not persisted and never shown verified. SR-E27-18 classes a 10002 clock-drift probe as inconclusive, never a verdict about the key, so a 502 exchange_error is recorded and raised as a contract question (plan DC-31). The reason names clock sync, the measured offset and the fix (sync the host clock); the exchange code only in a details disclosure.
